name: x402
summary: An open standard (Apache-2.0, stewarded by the x402 Foundation) for paying for an HTTP resource in the request itself: a server answers an unpaid request with 402 and a PAYMENT-REQUIRED header naming what it accepts, the client pays in a stablecoin and retries with the payment attached, no account, session or API key involved. The standard is free to use; each resource behind it has its own price. Reference SDKs, a facilitator role and a discovery catalog (the Bazaar) are part of the ecosystem, not of the standard.

agentAccess.notes: No account: the docs say clients pay without accounts, sessions or credentials, and a live seller measured 2026-09-09 answered an unpaid POST with 402 and a v2 PAYMENT-REQUIRED header. Needed instead: a funded wallet (a signature is the auth) and each call's price; a human funds the wallet.
